name: Drill Dracula: The Count Goes Down
summary:
The earth is full of many minerals and resources, but none as lucrative as the sacred Blood Diamond, and when he hears "Blood", Dracula's all in. Can you get to the end of this graveyard, and secure the diamond for yourself?

Drill your way through an onslaught of enemies with your blood-powered drill, selling all the minerals you find to get your hands on Dracula's many abilities, like his signature fangs, his classic bat form, and his infamous buzzsaw.

Made in 96 hours for the 2026 GMTK Game Jam - The theme was "Count Down", which motivated the central blood-timer mechanic, and of course, the "Count" going "Down" (To the center of the earth).
